excerpt.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
excerpt.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
texts.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

sections.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
sections.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 一块铝板被发现于[From.GetName]周围漂浮的碎石中，它的阳极化表面使它从周围的金属残骸中脱颖而出。它上面绘有两只模样滑稽的哺乳动物，还有一些无趣的几何形状。
texts.en: An aluminum plaque is found drifting among the detritus around [From.GetName], its anodized surface standing out from the metal debris surrounding it. It depicts two ridiculous-looking mammalian figures and some rather tasteless geometric shapes.

label.zh: 也许可以当我酒杯的杯垫。
label.en: It might make a good coaster for my drink.

tooltips.zh: 将太阳系坐标加入情报日志。
tooltips.en: Adds the coordinates of the Sol system to the Situation Log.

label.zh: 肯定有人愿意出价购买。
label.en: I'm sure someone would be willing to pay for it.

texts.zh: 一件外星人文物提供了一个特定星系的坐标。
texts.en: An alien artifact provides the coordinates for a particular system.

texts.zh: 一块阳极镀金的铝板被发现于[From.GetName]的表面。在进行任何分析和数据对比之前，[Root.GetName]上的所有成员就已经认识到了它的来源。
texts.en: An aluminum plate, anodized gold, is recovered from the surface of [From.GetName]. Everyone aboard the [Root.GetName] recognize it long before analysis and database cross-referencing confirm its origins.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在调查[From.GetName]微弱引力场时发现了一张金色碟片。碟片已被收回，初步分析表明其表面的细槽可能是由某种外星文明所创作的经过加密的音频和视频数据。
texts.en: A golden disc strikes the forward viewport of the [Root.GetName] as it is surveying the weak gravitational field of [From.GetName]. The object is recovered, and cursory analysis indicates that the minuscule grooves on the disc's surface might be encoded audio and video data, authored by some alien civilization.

label.zh: 也许可以当大酒杯的杯垫。
label.en: It might make a good coaster for a very big drink.

tooltips.zh: 将太阳系坐标加入情报日志。
tooltips.en: Adds the Sol system coordinates to the Situation Log.

label.zh: 外星音乐爱好者肯定会出大价钱。
label.en: Xeno-audiophiles would pay a lot for this.

texts.zh:
我们误以为是矿物簇的物体实际上是两艘外星护卫舰的金属外壳，它们正悄悄飘过小行星带。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]已经与其建立联系，这两艘船的船员自称他们以前都是海盗，现在被首领放逐了。他们听说[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle][Root.Owner.GetRulerName]是[Root.Owner.GetName]的统治者，为人亲民，特来寻求庇护。
texts.en:
What was thought to be a cluster of minerals are the metal hulls of two alien corvettes, stealthily drifting through the asteroid belt.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] established contact, and the two ships are crewed by alleged former pirates, now cast out from their robber-clan. They have heard whispers that [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] of the [Root.Owner.GetName] is a champion of the people, and seek asylum.

texts.zh:
我们误以为是矿脉的物体实际上是两艘外星护卫舰的金属外壳，它们正悄悄飘过小行星带。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]已经与其建立联系，这两艘船的船员自称他们以前都是海盗，现在被匪帮首领放逐了。很神奇的是，他们相信我们会妥善对待他们，因此特来寻求庇护。
texts.en:
What was thought to be a cluster of minerals are the metal hulls of two alien corvettes, stealthily drifting through the asteroid belt.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] established contact, and the two ships are crewed by alleged former pirates, now cast out from their robber-clan. Curiously, they believe that we will be well-disposed towards them, and are seeking asylum.

label.zh: 我们不需要他们的帮忙。把他们的东西都没收，只留他们一条命吧。
label.en: We do not need their services. Take what they have but their lives.

label.zh: [Root.Owner.GetName]不能容忍他们这种家伙存在。
label.en: The [Root.Owner.GetName] will not suffer the existence of their kind.

label.zh: 我们必须拒绝他们的避难请求。
label.en: We must deny their asylum claim.
